scripts.build: npm run build --workspace functions && npm run build --workspace apps/admin-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace functions && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/admin-web
scripts.emulators: npm run build --workspace functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-ghostai --only auth,firestore,functions
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-ghostai --only auth,firestore,functions 'node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-name-pattern="native note|tenant and job|repair writes require|permission changes|real HTTP|credential|Executive|SMS consent" functions/test/*.test.mjs'
scripts.test:full: npm run build --workspace functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-ghostai --only auth,firestore,functions 'node --test --test-concurrency=1 functions/test/*.test.mjs'
scripts.setup:twilio: npm run build --workspace functions && node scripts/configure-twilio.mjs
scripts.test:sms: npm run build --workspace functions && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-ghostai --only auth,firestore 'node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-name-pattern="SMS transport|SMS consent|credential|Twilio onboarding" functions/test/integration.test.mjs'
